scope: Historical conditional replay, all original APIs and queries. The frozen selected calls are output evidence only. Archived intent/concept labels are conditioned inputs, not independent model predictions. Literal named sources/provenance/input subjects are reconstructed from original query text; full raw Understand DTOs were not archived. No live model/provider or accuracy claim.
